premise: Call-home day, and the picture from Earth is all crackles; Drone flies up to look at the dish, Engineer fixes it at the mast, and the satellite's signal comes through — a class of children waving.
inspiration: Grimm's 'The Six Servants' (each helper has one gift), turned: two helpers and a wrench get a hello across space.
lesson: Each of us has one thing we're good at, and together that's enough.

en-US.title: The Broken Dish
en-US.text: It was call-home day. On Earth, a whole class of children was waiting to say hello. {satellite:enter} The satellite was ready. But the picture came through fuzzy, all crackles and snow. {sfx:static} {engineer:enter} {engineer:face surprised} Hmm, said Engineer. It must be the dish. {drone:float loop 0.3} Up flew {drone:enter} Drone, to the top of the radio mast, and {drone:live} took a close-up. Flash! There it was: the dish, knocked a little out of line. {engineer:face happy} Easy, said Engineer. {engineer:go to mast} She loped over to the foot of the mast. {engineer:live hold} Turn. Tighten. Sparks! One last hard twist… {engineer:live resume} {satellite:live} And the signal came through, clear as glass. {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} [excited] There they were: thirty children, waving! {robot:face happy} {robot:wobble} Robot waved back so hard his antenna wobbled. {all:face happy} Hello, Moon! they shouted. [happily] Hello, Earth!

es-ES.title: La antena torcida
es-ES.text: Era el día de llamar a casa. En la Tierra, toda una clase de niños y niñas esperaba para saludar. {satellite:enter} El satélite estaba listo. Pero la imagen llegaba borrosa, llena de chisporroteos y puntitos. {sfx:static} {engineer:enter} {engineer:face surprised} Mmm, dijo Ingeniera. Debe de ser la antena. {drone:float loop 0.3} {drone:enter} Dron subió volando hasta lo alto del mástil y {drone:live} sacó una foto de cerca. ¡Flash! Ahí estaba: la antena, un poquito torcida. {engineer:face happy} Pan comido, dijo Ingeniera. {engineer:go to mast} Fue a zancadas hasta el pie del mástil. {engineer:live hold} Girar. Apretar. ¡Chispas! Una última vuelta fuerte… {engineer:live resume} {satellite:live} Y la señal llegó, clara como el cristal. {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} [excited] ¡Allí estaban: treinta niños y niñas, saludando! {robot:face happy} {robot:wobble} Robot los saludó con tantas ganas que se le bamboleó la antena. {all:face happy} ¡Hola, Luna! gritaron. [happily] ¡Hola, Tierra!

static.prompt: a short burst of soft radio static and crackle, not harsh
